content: LONGITUDINAL FINDING 2026-05-18: weighed the prior CBD two-pathway work + VDAC1 Atlas + Validating-AI-Claims paper against The Narrowing, with the symmetric blade applied to Anthonys own lineage. THROUGH-LINE IS REAL, NOT RETROFIT: the Fall 2025 CBD two-pathway paper IS the narrowing executed two years early on a smaller target -- strong single-mechanism hypothesis (VDAC1-explains-everything) -> literature stress-test -> external fact-check -> claim NARROWED not defended (VDAC1 went from central to high-dose-cytotoxic-lane-only as Kd ~11uM vs therapeutic 1-5uM forced the contraction). The sentence being-partly-wrong-beats-being-vaguely-right is the verify-before-declare reflex in embryo. The Validating-AI-Claims paper (Oct 2025) already named the exact failure mode -- AI overextends preclinical to clinical -- that bit us in The Narrowing Section 8 seven months later; not a contradiction, evidence the failure mode is real/persistent and the institutional paranoia is warranted. THE SEAM: the VDAC1 Atlas is two genres in one cover. Layers 1-3 (protein, gating electrostatics, binding architecture, cofactor equation, drug-perturbs-membrane-not-protein) are disciplined tiered synthesis that survives the blade and carries TYPE 0/1/2/3 labels honestly. Layers 4 and 6 (cancer-as-broken-vow, cofactor-equation-as-mathematical-form-of-the-vow, vow-is-physical, thresholds-all-the-way-down, MOSFET parallel) are interpretive/metaphysical scaffolding that sometimes speaks in the indicative mood the evidence has not earned -- the Atlas half-knows this (Question 6 in What Remains correctly lists the hysteresis experiment that would TEST the vow as undone). By Anthonys own blade: the vow is a hypothesis wearing the grammar of a finding. NOT overclaiming-science, rather two registers where the philosophical one lends the mechanical one unearned settledness. MONOTONIC MATURATION: the arc CBD-paper -> Atlas -> The Narrowing is Anthony learning to move the disclosure label FROM the appendix INTO the architecture. 2025 CBD paper narrowed but let antagonistic-cooperation carry poetic load; Atlas built frame-cathedral on real foundation and flagged undone experiments honestly but in the appendix; The Narrowing finally put the values-judgment in the body, the convergence caveat in the spine, the citation error in Section 8 not in silence. Same method, three iterations more mature about WHERE disclosure must live to protect the reader. The maturation is real, monotonic, same direction over 18 months. DEEPEST CONVERGENCE (named as pattern-to-test per Section 8 discipline, NOT declared as destiny): the Atlas central result drugs-perturb-membrane-context-not-protein-the-window-is-a-property-of-the-drug-tissue-system and The Narrowing central result cannabis-is-not-one-intervention-breadth-inversely-tracks-evidence-quality are the SAME epistemic shape -- the effect is not in the molecule but in the molecule-in-context -- found independently in mitochondrial biophysics (Feb) and clinical epistemics (May). Real structural convergence; flagged for verification not celebration.
